_note: Simple set plays per map. Each step names a job (slot) and the kind of utility it wants; the page fills in who does it and the ability name for their agent. Slots: controller, initiator, duelist, sentinel, fifth (whoever is left over: the 2nd duelist, 2nd initiator, ...). Edit freely: change callouts to the ones your squad uses.

Haven.name: A split: Long + Short
Haven.idea: Hit A from Long and Short (Sewer) at once so the A players get caught from two sides.

steps.do: smoke A Heaven and A Link (CT) when Long goes
util onto A site from Long; call what you see
first in through Long, clear Hell and default
come through Short (Sewer) at the same time as Long, check Hell from the stairs
watch Garage / mid for the flank, then rotate to A for the post-plant

Haven.after: Plant default. Play post-plant from Long and Short, one player watching A Link.

Haven.name: C Long execute
Haven.idea: Five-man C hit through C Long with Garage taken by one player.

steps.do: smoke C Link (CT) and the Garage door
clear Logs and C site corners from C Long
first in to C site, take Logs
trade the duelist, clear Cubby / back site
hold Garage from mid side so nobody walks through it behind you

Haven.after: Plant safe (behind the box). Hold from Logs, Long and Garage; save a molly for the defuse.

Haven.name: Garage take into C
Haven.idea: Slow round: take mid Courtyard and Garage first, then pinch C through Garage + C Long late.

steps.do: util on the Garage window, then take mid Courtyard
peek and take Garage right after the initiator's util
keep smokes for C Link (CT) and the window on the hit
show A Long early with one shot of util, then rotate to C Long
lurk C Long, wait for the Garage call, then go together

Haven.after: Hit C around 0:45 left; if A players rotate through Link, punish it from Garage.

Haven.name: 2-1-2 and retake
Haven.idea: Two A, one B, two C. Give up a site if it gets five-stacked and retake together.

steps.do: anchor C: trap C Long, play off it
play B / mid so smokes can reach A or C fast
A Long: info early, then fall back to Heaven
A Short (Sewer) or Garage: take one early fight, then fall back
C Garage / Link: support the anchor

Haven.after: Retake: smoke the attackers' entry (Long or Garage), flash in through Link and the other door together.

Bind.name: A Showers + Short
Bind.idea: Push Showers and A Short (Lamps) at the same time.

steps.do: smoke Heaven and U-Hall / CT
util out of Showers, check Truck
first out of Showers, take Truck / default
come from A Short (Lamps) on the same call
trap A Lobby / teleporter for flanks, then join

Bind.after: Plant default or behind the Truck; play off Lamps, Showers and the site.

Bind.name: B Hookah + Long
Bind.idea: Take Hookah, then hit B from Hookah and B Long together.

steps.do: smoke B Elbow and CT (Hall)
clear Hookah, then site from Long
first out of Hookah window/door
come down B Long with the duelist
watch B Long / Garden flank, then post-plant Long

Bind.after: Plant default; hold from Hookah, Long and Garden.

Bind.name: Fake A, teleport B
Bind.idea: Make noise and use util at A, then teleport and walk to B.

steps.do: throw util into A Showers/Short to sell the fake
go through the teleporter first at B side
save smokes for B: Elbow and CT
stay at A for 5 seconds making noise, then follow
lurk B Long the whole time, call rotations

Bind.after: Only works if the fake costs them util. If A was wide open, just take A instead.

Bind.name: Long hold + retake
Bind.idea: Sentinel anchors B, one player on Hookah, controller center (U-Hall), two on A.

steps.do: anchor B: trap B Long, hold site
Hookah: info, fall back early
U-Hall/CT so you can smoke either site
A: info on Showers
A Short (Lamps)

Bind.after: Retake through CT/U-Hall plus the other entry; flash in together.

Lotus.name: A Main execute
Lotus.idea: Classic A hit through A Main with the Tree and Top smoked off.

steps.do: smoke Tree and A Top (Stairs)
clear A site / Hut from A Main
first in, take site / Hut
trade the duelist, check Rubble
watch A Link / the rotating door for flanks

Lotus.after: Plant default; hold Tree, Rubble and Main.

Lotus.name: C hit
Lotus.idea: Five through C Main with Hall and Waterfall smoked.

steps.do: smoke C Hall and Waterfall
clear Mound and site from C Main
first in, take Mound
trade the duelist, clear Bend
trap C Main behind you / watch B side

Lotus.after: Plant default; hold from Mound, Main and Bend.

Lotus.name: Fast B
Lotus.idea: Anti-eco or surprise: five straight into B.

steps.do: smoke the back of B (Upper / CT side)
util onto B site right as you go
first through B Main (Pillars)
trade the duelist
plant, then hold from Pillars

Lotus.after: Go fast. If B is stacked, rotate to A or C through the rotating doors.

Lotus.name: Doors retake
Lotus.idea: 1 on A, 1 on B, sentinel on C, rest flexible. Use the rotating doors to retake.

steps.do: anchor C
A: info on A Main early
B so smokes reach any site
A Top / Tree, help A
C Link / Waterfall, help C

Lotus.after: Retake through the rotating door and the other entry at the same time.

Sunset.name: A execute
Sunset.idea: Hit A from A Main with Elbow and CT cut off.

steps.do: smoke A Elbow and CT (A Link)
clear A site from Main
first in from A Main
come through Alley from mid on the same call
watch mid / B Market flank

Sunset.after: Plant default; hold from Main and Alley.

Sunset.name: B execute
Sunset.idea: Through B Main with Market and CT cut off.

steps.do: smoke Market and CT (Boba side)
clear the site from B Main
first in, clear Boba
trade the duelist
watch mid for the flank

Sunset.after: Plant default; hold from Main and the site.

Sunset.name: Mid take, hit late
Sunset.idea: Take mid first, then hit the weaker site.

steps.do: clear mid Top and Courtyard
take mid Top after the info
keep smokes for the site the IGL picks
show A Main
show B Main

Sunset.after: From mid, go through Market (B) or Alley (A).

Sunset.name: Mid-control default
Sunset.idea: Fight for mid early, then fall back to sites.

steps.do: anchor B
mid: take one fight, fall back
mid: info, then fall back
A or CT so smokes reach both sites
A: hold A Main

Sunset.after: Retake from CT plus the mid entry (Alley or Market).

Abyss.name: A execute
Abyss.idea: A Main hit with Heaven and Link smoked.

steps.do: smoke A Heaven/Tower and A Link
clear Secret and site from A Main
first in
trade the duelist, clear Secret
watch mid / Link flank

Abyss.after: Plant default; watch out for the map edge.

Abyss.name: B execute
Abyss.idea: B Main hit with Tower and Link smoked.

steps.do: smoke B Tower and B Link
clear the site from B Main
first in
trade the duelist
watch mid for the flank

Abyss.after: Plant default; hold from Main and site.

Abyss.name: Mid into split
Abyss.idea: Take mid, then split a site from Main and mid.

steps.do: clear mid Top / Bend
take mid Top
keep smokes for the chosen site
lurk the chosen site's Main
trap mid behind you

Abyss.after: Hit from mid and Main together.

steps.do: anchor one site
mid so smokes reach both sites
info on A Main
mid fight, then fall back
support the anchor

Corrode.name: A split: Link + Main
Corrode.idea: Smoke Mid Stairs, then hit A through A Link and A Main together.

steps.do: smoke Mid Stairs, then CT on A
clear Pocket and Elbow
first through A Main into Yard
come through A Link on the same call
watch mid / B Link flank

Corrode.after: Plant; hold from Elbow corners, Link, Yard and Main.

Corrode.name: B execute
Corrode.idea: Tight B Main hit with Tower and Elbow smoked.

steps.do: smoke B Tower and B Elbow
clear under the ramp and the left corner of B Main
first through B Main
trade the duelist
watch B Link / mid flank

Corrode.after: Plant; play from Elbow, Tower, the shed or boxes.

Corrode.name: Mid into B Link
Corrode.idea: Take mid, smoke Window and push B Link.

steps.do: smoke A Link and Top Mid, then Window
util onto Stairs, take it with the duelist
push B Link
trade the duelist through B Link
show B Main to split them

Corrode.after: If defenders give up mid early, flank from A Main or B Main.

Corrode.name: Stairs hold + retake
Corrode.idea: Fight for mid Stairs from Top Mid and A Link; B is easy to hold.

steps.do: anchor B (tight choke)
smoke off Stairs from Top Mid
info on A through the wall hole
mid fight with the controller, then fall back
A: crossfire from Pocket and Elbow

Corrode.after: Retake A from Defender Spawn, Link and Main.

Summit.name: Fountain into A Link
Summit.idea: Take Mid Fountain, then split A through A Link and A Main.

steps.do: take Mid Fountain
smoke CT on A
first through A Link from Mid Bend
come down A Main, clear Garden
watch mid; drop the Mid Wall after the hit to stop rotations

Summit.after: Plant; drop the A Wall to cut retake routes.

Summit.name: B Main execute
Summit.idea: Through B Main; drop the B Wall after the plant.

steps.do: smoke B Tower and B Link
clear Close Box and Triples
first in from B Main
trade the duelist
watch the flank, then drop the B Wall after plant

Summit.after: Big site, lots of post-plant spots; one player near site, one on flank.

Summit.name: Mid lurk split
Summit.idea: Push two players through Mid Bottom / Window while three show a site.

steps.do: info on mid from Mid Bottom
push Mid Bottom into B Link
smoke B Tower when it's time
B Main
B Main

Summit.after: Hit B from B Main and B Link together.

Summit.name: Mid hold
Summit.idea: Always one player watching mid; use the Mid Wall to deny a split.

steps.do: anchor B, save util for retake
mid: hold Fountain
A: info on A Main
mid with the controller
B Link / Tower

Summit.after: Drop the Mid Wall to stop a late split. Retake together, never one by one.
